reason: Adds a Harness replay view that visualizes agent-session events, supports search and playback, and exports a redacted standalone HTML replay for sharing.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将 Agent 会话转换为可搜索、可回放的时间线，并导出经过脱敏的交互式 HTML 分享页。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness view for searching and replaying agent-session timelines and exporting redacted interactive HTML pages for sharing.

capabilities: Reads existing Harness session snapshots in the browser
Displays searchable and filterable agent-session timelines
Replays recorded session events at selectable speeds
Exports selected session events as an interactive HTML file
Redacts several common paths, tokens, and credential formats before export
